rule: minimum RMS material change from raw among legal paid discrepancy-feasible candidates; Phi then candidate index break exact ties; primary fallback
prior_semantics: Explicit raw-anchor preference, different from minPhi or minR. This is selection/retention, not improved same-objective optimization.
cost_policy: All original proposal/corrector costs retained; selection scan is extra CPU on its declared host, not a cross-host end-to-end timing sum. No measured skipped-corrector or full-wave saving.
